messages.subject: Falcon - DD findings and SPA strategy
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Tom,

DD is largely complete. The material points for the SPA / Red Flag report are: (1) Severn Aero customer concentration ~18%, contract terminable on 6 months' notice, re-tender Q2 2026; (2) loss-making Halton Marine tooling contract (~£85k to Dec 2026); (3) intimated unfair dismissal claim (Sharp); (4) the HMRC R&D enquiry. 

My recommendation: push the escrow to 24 months given the HMRC enquiry, take a specific indemnity for the R&D clawback, a capped indemnity for Sharp, and reflect Severn Aero in the earn-out. I'll mark these into our SPA draft. Thoughts before I send v2 to Castle & Vane?

James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Corporate
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
